name: PlayHands_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its hands to chest height and playfully taps its fingers together as if fidgeting.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises both arms, bringing its hands together in front of its chest. It then playfully taps and rolls its fingers against each other in a light, fidgeting motion while looking slightly downward toward its hands. Finally, it separates its hands, lowers its arms, and smoothly returns to its default standing posture.
safety_notes: The arms move in front of the chest, requiring minimal lateral clearance, but standard safety buffer zones around the robot front should be respected.
